rung_purposes.purpose: Energize HiPot start and HV beacon if pallet present, door closed, E-stop OK, and no test result.
Latch HiPot PASS status bit M310 upon receiving tester PASS signal X30.
Latch HiPot FAIL status bit M311 upon receiving tester FAIL signal X31.
Reset HiPot PASS and FAIL status bits on falling edge of pallet present sensor X33.
